english.title: Deface / alter / amend a ticket issued for the purpose of entering a taxi feeder park on Gatwick Airport
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 9(17) and 2(3) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
